risk_summary: The excerpt presents strong, highly quantified year-over-year growth, improved margins, and stronger earnings, producing a generally confident tone. Key risks include supply-chain bottlenecks, inflation, reliance on favorable end-market conditions, and impairment sensitivity to projected cash flows, demand, pricing, and discount rates. Some sales drivers and product-mix effects cannot be directly quantified, and the discussion repeats metrics across sections.
